provenance.paper_title: Personalizing Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model Agents over Long-term User Interactions

evidence.paraphrase: Multimodal knowledge-graph entries for semantic memory and episodic embodied memory. retrieves relevant memories to interpret implicit personalized requests and guide task execution.
During operation, POLAR applies LLM-mediated memory editing to personalized semantic context; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, POLAR applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to personalized semantic context; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, POLAR applies abstraction of episodes into reusable experience to personalized semantic context; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (personalized semantic context) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
